hypotheses.hypothesis: The ad service failures are caused by severe timeouts in feature flag streaming evaluations against flagd, reaching the 15,000ms threshold
hypotheses.evidence: if failed flagd streams caused the failed ad requests, there would be at least as many of them: the flagd stream errors were 0.0042 a second against 0.0167 failed GetAds calls a second at 05:08:00Z, so the query returns nothing: the stream errors are too few to be the cause of the failed requests. The 15-second EventStream spans the agent saw are real (p95 15,000 ms at 05:08:00Z), but the window before the onset holds none, which fits a stream reconnecting when flagd's flags changed at the onset (I did not verify that mechanism).
